name: Peel Off
summary: Week planner where removing an event peels its sticker off corner first and lets it fall away
about: Peel Off treats calendar events as stickers on a planner page. Removing one lifts its corner, peels it diagonally to show the white back, then lets it drift down off the week while a sticky outline fades from the slot. The event and hour totals update, guests can be told, and Undo floats the sticker back up and presses it flat with a shine.
how: Tap an event sticker in the week to select it; its corner starts to lift.
Choose whether to tell the guests, then press Remove event.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) within six seconds to stick it back on.
Reset week puts every event back where it started.
